description: Rewrites the last assistant reply into a short everyday analog (one metaphor, numbered roles, mix-up named, one-sentence rule). Use when the user types /simplify with no extra text, or says something is unclear, too technical, jargon, "I don't get it", "make it simpler", "like last time", "non-technical", "tldr but human", or ELI5. Bare /simplify means: explain that previous message; do not ask them to paste or restate the confusing part.
